gtoc13_normalization.time_bonus_rule: c = 1.13 for elapsed_days <= 7; c = 1.165 - 0.005 * elapsed_days otherwise
gtoc13_normalization.selection_policy: Rescore only the best entry retained on the final official leaderboard; other submissions are not available here.

gtocx_normalization.timezone_note: The static archive does not label row timezones. UTC-05:00 is inferred and cross-checked against the two early public final solutions with significant bonus (Jena and Citadel). Normalized timestamps remain estimates.
gtocx_normalization.time_bonus_epoch_note: The organizer says bonus used server checking time to the second, which can lag the displayed submission epoch.
gtocx_normalization.selection_policy: Rescore the same best submission retained for each team on the final leaderboard.

gtoc11_normalization.post_close_display_policy: Keep published timestamps; clamp B to 1 after close for the approximate normalization only.
gtoc11_normalization.all_rows_method: Approximate from displayed score and best-submission UTC. Exact team submissions are not identified.
